categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters. It contains three separate orders under the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act approving the acquisition of specific immovable properties (land allotments) for construction projects. Each order includes detailed descriptions of the land parcels, including their location, boundaries, extent (in perch), and claimant information. The content focuses exclusively on land/property matters without involving government personnel changes, structural reorganizations, or other specialized categories like legal, commercial, or public service matters.
